title: Hardy spaces of discrete holomorphic functions on the upper half-lattice
summary: We develop a theory of Hardy spaces $H^p$ of discrete holomorphic functions on the upper half-lattice, within the classical framework of discrete holomorphicity on the square lattice. We prove Cauchy and Poisson reproducing formulas, establish a boundary norm identity, and obtain Paley--Wiener type characterizations for these spaces.
